weak_alpha.component_location_summary: Components are source-local coordinate boxes with distance to nearest alpha>=16 pixel in each frame. Every omitted pixel is alpha 1, never attached to the alpha>=16 silhouette; K5/K7 have some tail-side/margin-adjacent flecks, but their alpha=1 is 1/255 opacity and their nearest alpha>=16 gaps are 32.8px (K5) and 9.0px (K7) in raw source units. No clipped paw/body/ear was found in this class.
weak_alpha.visual_impact_at_fixed_64_world_scale: At 27/56 source-to-cell scale followed by 64/256 display scale, each source pixel covers about 0.12 output pixels. Alpha 1/255 marks cannot add a readable limb, ear, or tail contour. They appear only as sparse magenta audit pixels when deliberately recolored; original low-opacity pixels are effectively imperceptible.

fixed_scale_geometry.fixed_world_display_scale: 64/192 = 1/3 source cell px to world px
fixed_scale_geometry.comparison: Matched broad heads remain 94-95px. Walk body alpha height is about 176-180px (58.7-60.0wu) versus idle 191-192px (63.7-64.0wu); the torso orange-vest proxy is 42-45px versus idle 49px. This is a real body/vest source-proportion gap under the shared scale; some extra height difference is natural gait crouch, but vest shortening is not explained by the lower legs alone and remains open.

anchor_method: Manual sole-contact x is the horizontal midpoint of the alpha>=16 outsole run on the lowest visible row in the support-boot ROI; row may be y228 where antialias/rounding leaves one transparent row above registered y229 baseline. Coordinates are cell pixel centers; world x = pixel x/3 at fixed 64/192 scale. Raw source bounds are inverse-mapped from the registered ROI using the frozen 27/56 scale and per-frame rigid paste offset.

anchor_travel_analysis.interpretation: Near support advances right about 3.0 world px per pose across K1-K4, short of +13 needed to hold a world-space foot point while the character moves west 13px/pose; expected residual slide is roughly 10px/pose. Far support x marks are less regular and include a low-confidence K5/K7 segment, so no clean cycle-wide estimate is claimed. This is an art-side contact diagnostic, not a stride/timing change.

support_foot_roi_sheet.description: Whole 256px cells with 16px grid and enlarged support-foot ROIs for manual contact marking; labels specify planned support leg and ROI.

support_sole_coordinate_detail.description: Support-leg sole crop at 4x nearest-neighbor with x labels every 8 cell pixels and red y=229 ground line; used to record manual x centers.

weak_alpha_source_trace.description: Raw atlas crops with the 398 alpha 1..15 pixels outside render crops recolored magenta for source-context tracing.

open_findings: V4 is still a proposal; root acceptance/integration required.
Vest/body proportions remain shorter than approved idle at the shared head scale.
K5 support contact is low confidence and K7 has leg overlap; far-foot cycle anchor is therefore provisional.
The art-side support contacts move too little to cancel the current 13-world-px-per-pose westward translation; runtime stride remains root-owned.
